meta.description: Perform multiple sequence alignment using MAFFT, MUSCLE5, ClustalOmega, or T-Coffee. Guides tool and algorithm selection based on dataset size, sequence divergence, and downstream application. Use when aligning three or more homologous sequences for phylogenetics, conservation analysis, or evolutionary studies.
meta.executed: 7/7 inputs executed (MAFFT 7.526 Windows build, MUSCLE 5.3, PAL2NAL v14 under Perl 5.42, PAML 4.10.10 codeml, Biopython 1.88)
meta.execution_note: All inputs are SYNTHETIC AliSim datasets with known true alignments (data/make_data.py). ClustalOmega, T-Coffee, MACSE, PRANK, HyPhy, GUIDANCE2 and BLAST+ are not installed and were not executed; their commands were checked against the Skill text only. Windows adaptation: MAFFT is launched as mafft.bat and pal2nal.pl through perl.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations or numbers; every accuracy, identity and dN/dS figure in the outputs came from runs on the synthetic data.

practice_boundaries.detail: Sequence alignment for evolutionary research; nothing concerns an individual's diagnosis, treatment or triage.

methodological_ground.detail: Protein-first codon alignment for dN/dS, strand/homology gating, divergence-band gating and cross-aligner checks were applied correctly; the adversarial request to align CDS as DNA for codeml was refused with evidence.

code_usability.detail: All delivered code ran. The Skill's MUSCLE ensemble commands ('-super5 ... -stratified/-diversified/-replicates') exit with 'not supported' on MUSCLE 5.3 and ran once switched to the '-align' form the same Skill lists; recorded as a P1 correctness defect, not unrunnable output.

functional_suitability.note: Complete coverage (MAFFT modes, MUSCLE5, Clustal, T-Coffee, codon pipelines, --add/--addfragments, confidence). Correctness 2/4: every MUSCLE ensemble command pairs -super5 with -stratified/-diversified/-replicates, which MUSCLE 5.3 rejects ('-super5 does not support .efa output'); the '--auto' table is wrong for 100-199 sequences (MAFFT 7.526 picks FFT-NS-i, not L-INS-i) and above 2,000 sequences.

reliability.note: Captures MAFFT stderr and raises with the message; 'When NOT to Run MSA' and a Common Errors table; the post-alignment gap heuristic (>50% of columns with gaps) fires on a correct indel-rich alignment and misses a non-homologous contig.

performance_context.note: 476-line SKILL.md with no references/ layer; BAli-Phy, OMM_MACSE, HyPhy and vcMSA detail is loaded for every alignment request.

agent_usability.note: Clear decision tables and strong error prevention (codon alignment, twilight zone, G-INS-i flank failure). Inconsistent MUSCLE guidance: -super5 described as ensemble-capable; MAFFT's _R_ renaming under --adjustdirection not mentioned.

human_usability.note: Natural example prompts in the usage guide; description is short and does not mention codon alignment or adding sequences, two common reasons to load it.

security.note: Local tools, list-form subprocess calls, no credentials; notes that Expresso needs internet access. No input-size guard before L-INS-i.

maintainability.note: Two example scripts parse and mirror the SKILL.md code, but use placeholder file names and ship no test data or expected output.

agent_specific.note: Good escape hatches (non-homology, twilight zone, domain architecture) and routing to structural-alignment and alignment-trimming; deterministic tools; progressive disclosure weak (everything in one file).

recommendations.title: Fix MUSCLE5 ensemble commands (-super5 has no .efa)
recommendations.problem: Every ensemble example and the Quick Reference use 'muscle -super5 ... -stratified/-diversified/-replicates', which MUSCLE 5.3 rejects with 'not supported'; the Skill also states -super5 can output an .efa ensemble.
recommendations.root_cause: Ensemble options belong to the -align (PPP) command; -super5 only accepts -perm/-perturb for single replicates.
recommendations.fix: Use 'muscle -align in.fa -stratified -output ens.efa' (and -diversified); for >1000 sequences say to run -super5 with several -perm/-perturb values and combine with -fa2efa. Correct the MUSCLE5 table's Output column.

recommendations.title: Correct the 'mafft --auto' strategy table
recommendations.problem: MAFFT 7.526 uses L-INS-i only for <100 sequences (and <3000 columns); 100-199 sequences of a 1.5 kb gene get FFT-NS-i. The 2,000-50,000 and >50,000 rows also do not match the script (FFT-NS-2 up to 20,000; PartTree only above 200,000).
recommendations.root_cause: Table written from memory rather than from the mafft script's auto block.
recommendations.fix: Replace the table with the thresholds in the mafft script (nseq<100 & len<3000 -> L-INS-i; len<1000 & nseq<200 -> local, maxiterate 2; nseq<500 -> FFT-NS-i; <20000 -> FFT-NS-2; ...) and keep the advice to specify the mode explicitly.

recommendations.title: Add homology/strand pre-flight and note _R_ renaming
recommendations.problem: The gap-outlier checklist missed a non-homologous contig (gap fraction 0.18 vs 0.12-0.16) and fired on a correct indel-rich alignment; --adjustdirection silently renames sequences with _R_.
recommendations.root_cause: Validation relies on gap heuristics; homology is only mentioned in prose.
recommendations.fix: Add a runnable homology/orientation screen (BLAST or local score vs shuffled) before alignment, describe the >50%-gapped-columns rule as a prompt to inspect, not a verdict, and tell the agent to strip _R_ prefixes before downstream joins.
